name: Legislation of the Republic of Azerbaijan (Constitution, referendum acts, constitutional laws, codes and laws)
label: Azerbaijan
record_note: e-qanun.az texts retrieved 2026-10-28. Dated editions are kept by e-qanun mostly from 2021; before an act's first kept edition, articles that carry amendment notes appear only from the in-force date of the latest act they cite (Kind: baseline).

dates.commit: in-force (e-qanun requisite "effectDate" of the act that made the change; first official publication where e-qanun gives none)

author.amendment: the act named by e-qanun's note on the changed text

scope.when_absent: no scope note extracted; not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: no retroactive effect unless the act says so; never to establish or aggravate liability
default_reach.meaning: a normative legal act applies to relations arising after it takes effect; laws that establish or aggravate legal liability have no retroactive force, and laws that remove or mitigate it do
default_reach.authority: Constitution of the Republic of Azerbaijan, article 149(VII); Constitutional Law on Normative Legal Acts (No. 21-IVKQ, 21 December 2010), article 87
